tasks.request: In apps/cli/src/team.ts, ensure team serve reports the actual source flag when rejecting the reserved MARS identity (with any capitalization), for both --members and --dev-users. The validation should work even when no agent model is configured.

In packages/team-chat/src/mentions.ts, recognize full-width sentence punctuation and ellipses around @MARS invocations and file-and-line references just as ASCII punctuation is recognized; do not turn file references into agent prompts.
In apps/shell/scripts/package.ts, make the desktop staging directory canonical even if the OS temp directory is a symlink, so downstream private trust-store validation accepts it.
